rationale: Plan uses all four catalogue components. denial_code_ranking uses scope=all_claims to quantify code prevalence across the full population, and quantify_missing=by_status to understand how missing codes distribute by claim status (informative since 90% of claims lack denial codes). denial_rate_by_segment includes all five segment dimensions from the task objective. Denominator is adjudicated_claims per high-severity T2 feedback: denial rates must exclude Pended claims. min_group_size=30 flags small groups per task tag. Report includes synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats per T1 feedback applying to this dataset, and show_denominators=true per T2 feedback requirement to state numerator and denominator.
